Build AI that understands the world.

The world’s most important systems are physical. Help build the intelligence they deserve.

From the food we grow to the water, forests and assets we depend on, turn a changing planet into intelligence people can act on.

Explore open roles↗Discover the work ↓

Build models that farmers, food companies and governments act on every season.

Building for the physical world means working with complexity: changing weather, living systems, fragmented data and decisions that cannot wait.

Food and agriculture are our proving ground. We are extending that foundation across forests, water and the next frontiers of energy and infrastructure.
